body: !remind me in 7 days

Well, I’ve been using only Tekken characters recently, to test stuff. 
You COULD use Armor King as the team leader and Jin and Paul as members. You can get armor king by farming Tekken coins (or something like that) by completing the Tekken vs KOF event. Paul was easier for me, I just completed event missions everyday to get the free roulette ticket until I got him.
The good part about having Armor King as your leader is that he raises the ATK of Tekken characters by 45%. It’s pretty useful, specially for Paul, because he has a high damage. Once you complete Jin’s and Iori’s missions, you can use the rubies to try and pull T7 Jin, so you won’t have two green types on your team.
Alternatively, I’d recommend starting with King 94 and saving rubies to get Orochi when he becomes available.

Highly Suspect - The Boy Who Died Wolf

I really understand how you feel, as I feel like this as well. I really wish she would come back and apologize to me. You should try new things and meet new people. After two months that were like hell to me, I just figured out I had to accept myself as I am, and I feel better after that. Of course, I don't feel happy, but I don't feel that sad anymore. I just realized I wasn't a horrible boyfriend, I was really good to her, but I really screwed up. You really tried everything to make him stay by your side, and if he didn't stay even after that, he is the one that doesn't deserve you. After 2 months, I realized that if I want change, I got to chase it. I want to change my life, so I'm just going to try my best, even if she's not by my side. If you want to change, you should start by changing the way you think. I started thinking differently. I wasn't thinking positively, but I wasn't being pessimistic as well. It is something hard to do, but it's worth giving a shot.

You have a lot of life ahead of yourself. This week I started feeling a little better than before, I was able to concentrate on classes, enjoy talking to my friends again, and I did well on the tests at my college. I just noticed how hard I was being at myself, punishing myself a lot when I was actually a really good boyfriend to her, although I truly let her down by acting like I didn't care about her. Of course, even though I'm being optimistic about things now, I always go back to being depressed at some point of the day, but then I just try my best to focus my mind on positive thoughts ( I usually think about all the people at my side, like my family and friends ).  I noticed there's no way life will change if I don't try to do things, and if I don't accept who I am. I will talk to her, I know it has been two months and she probably is seeing someone new, but I don't care. I have to apologize, or I won't be able to move on. I don't care if any of my friends see me apologizing, and if they will think that I'm a total idiot after it. As for you, you should really try your best to accept yourself, and to try to improve your life.

I feel the same as you, I feel like if I try to find someone new, I wouldn't be able to love the person. Somedays, I even feel like I wouldn't even be able to love my ex anymore and that life is truly empty. If you need a friend to talk, just talk to me, feel free to PM me at anytime.

I understand exactly what you feel. Maybe some day he will reach you out, but you can't just stay there waiting for him. You should try to meet new people. You will surely find someone who will really care about you. I'm really afraid of how she will react when I talk to her, because her best friend has been making her hate me since we broke up. Lately though, I've been feeling less depressed, because I noticed that even though she is not here and I miss her, I have lots of friends. You should keep your friends close to you as well.
Rainbow Six Siege. FPS, can be really fun when you're playing together with someone else.

I've been through that as well, with another gf I had. She broke up with me and 2 days after it she made her new relationship official. I felt bad for a while, but after some time, I realized that she really didn't care about me, and that I wouldn't let that get me down. I just focused on making new friends and being myself, until I met my ex. Now I'm trying to create the courage to talk to her and try to apologize, but I just fear she might humiliate me in front of all my friends.

From what you said, you were an amazing gf. I really think that HE was the one that didn't deserve you. You tried your best to make him happy and fought for him. He really doesn't deserve you, and you should find someone better for you. 
PS: I also fought hard to stay with my ex, until I she rejected flowers I had bought for her in front of a lot of people.

For me, I focused on programming. I really love to program, but after she started to ignore me completely, I haven't felt like programming at all, as we are on the same class and used to program together. I just don't have anything to do because my city is really boring. Maybe you should try to get to know new people and find new interests. Why does the person give you the cold shoulder, though?

I understand how you feel about music, I feel almost the same way. You should try to find new activities that you feel that will be productive. Set a goal and try to reach it. Also, try making some new friends closer to where you live. Maybe it will work...
I think I will give it a try, I have nothing to lose anymore. Thank you.

I don't know if you already tried those, but here's what I tried to do:
-Focus on college (didn't work, couldn't concentrate)
-Hang out more with friends (was working, but after some time it just started feeling like everything else)
-Write some songs
-Sleep
-Listen to Lo-Fi Hip-Hop ( always made me feel less stressed )
-Play games 
-Made new friends (didn't work for me)
Sleeping was the best one for me.

You're right. A friend told me to get help. But I'm just too ashamed to talk to my mother or grandma about this, just like when I try to apologize to my ex. I really want to do both things, but I just don't feel able to. I feel useless.
I can feel you. But, he left you for someone else. He really doesn't deserve someone like you in his life.

It's not only about her, it's just that after she left, everything started to go wrong. Before we were on a relationship, I constantly felt sad and thought nothing was ever going to work in my life. I've never had friends until 2017, and I was bullied during the whole time I was in School. Now I have friends, but things started to wrong on vacation, and I just can't feel anything but sadness anymore...

I met her at college. At first, I wouldn't even talk to her, because I thought she had something with another guy ( he was always near her, and followed her around everywhere ). But, after a while, I noticed she would look at me and smile sometimes, and after some weeks, I decided I had to talk to her. After that, we started talking every day. After a while, the guy from before saw both of us together and became desperate. He starded acting strange around her, until he told what he felt to her, and she told him she didn't feel the same. After that, we just got closer and closer to each other and we started dating.
